summary: JIT grill of the per-task plan-mode-approval gate (Codex-designed) against current factory_lib/phase.py/forge.py. CLI shape, grounding-digest exclusion, and bootstrapping resolved; contract kept.
current_flow: After decomposition each task goes JIT contract -> task grill (--gate task, grounding_digest) -> stage start (require_ready_task: contract complete + fresh grill) -> delegate (same gate again). There is NO per-task plan artifact and NO per-task human approval; forge_cli/tasks.py does not exist; task_frontier_state routes author-contract->grill->stage-start->delegate.

criteria_map.stage start and delegate refuse a task w: test_stage_start_and_delegate_refuse_without_approved_task_plan synthesizes a fresh-grilled task with no task-plan/approval and asserts both stage start and write delegate refuse via require_ready_task(require_approval=True), and pass once forge task plan save + forge task approve stamp a matching digest
criteria_map.forge next and the board route author-ta: test_forge_next_and_board_route_author_task_plan_and_await_approval asserts task_frontier_state/phase.py and task_rows both surface author-task-plan then await-approval from the same predicates

new_abstractions: forge_cli/tasks.py (cmd_plan_save, cmd_approve) + per-task plan at .factory/stories/<KEY>/task-plans/<id>.md + approved_task_plan_sha256/approved_by/approved_at in the grill record - the per-task analogue of story plan approval. Reversible: pure gate token in the grill record, no new status/DB; reuses plan_digest_without_assumptions + require_task_grill + evidence_path.

options: Yes - keep task-plan OUT of grounding_digest

citations.finding: Approval is audited human attestation (--by), not cryptographic; grill precedes task-plan authoring so grounding must exclude it
require_ready_task is the shared seam both stage start and write delegate already call

resolutions: forge task plan save + forge task approve (operator 2026-08-19): a new `task` subcommand group keeps story-plan (forge plan, plans/active/) and task-plan (forge task, story dir) namespaces distinct.

Keep task-plan OUT of grounding_digest (operator 2026-08-19): grounding stays over {contract, approved story plan, product tree}; approval is a separate stamp compared by require_ready_task - folding it in would stale the just-passed grill on save. reviewer_focus enforces.

New default gates future stage starts only (operator 2026-08-19): require_ready_task(require_approval=True) affects task 3+; task 2's delegate already passed the old launch check, stage done only measures; the required refusal test SYNTHESIZES an unapproved task, never task 2's own state - no self-lock.
